grapes.name: Cococciola
grapes.origin: 长期记录于 Chieti，尤其 Vacri、Villamagna。
grapes.summary: 晚熟地方白葡萄，用于清新干白及起泡基酒。
grapes.viticulture: 大圆果粒、厚实果皮、大而不规则果穗；传统采用 pergola abruzzese，当地通常九月底至十月初采收。
grapes.winemaking: Abruzzo DOC 有 Cococciola 品种类别；已记录静止、起泡用途。
grapes.taste: 清新酸度、克制果香花香；木桶、甜度须按酒款判断。
grapes.confusions: 虽曾参与地方混酿，但与 Trebbiano Abruzzese 不同。

text.zh: Abruzzo DOC 有 Cococciola 品种类别；已记录静止、起泡用途。

text.en: Fresh acidity, restrained fruit and floral notes; oak and sweetness are wine-specific.
text.zh: 清新酸度、克制果香花香；木桶、甜度须按酒款判断。

text.en: A distinct variety, not Trebbiano Abruzzese despite historic blending use.

grapes.name: Montonico
grapes.origin: 保育于 Teramo 的 Bisenti、Cermignano 的 Poggio delle Rose。
grapes.summary: 兼具鲜食历史的地方葡萄，现用于静止白酒及起泡。
grapes.viticulture: 传统较丰产，果穗结实；保育园在 Gran Sasso 山麓，静止及起泡用途影响采收。
grapes.winemaking: Abruzzo DOC 设 Montonico 类别；起泡用途强调保留酸度。
grapes.taste: 清新、克制白果表达，不能假定为强芳香型。
grapes.confusions: 不能因拼写近似而并入 Calabria 的 Mantonico Bianco。

grapes.name: Tintilia
grapes.origin: 十九世纪初已在 Molise 记载；ARSARP 记录 Acquaviva Collecroce、Ferrazzano 材料。
grapes.summary: 以酸度、酚类结构、香料为参照的地方红葡萄，并不必然重萃取。
grapes.viticulture: 中小型疏松穗、厚皮、坐果不稳定；仍有白粉病及湿季霜霉病风险。
grapes.winemaking: Tintilia del Molise DOC 允许红、红 Riserva、桃红；钢罐或木桶依酒庄选择。
grapes.taste: ARSARP 记录清新酸度、胡椒／丁香类香料及显著酚类。
grapes.confusions: 不是 Tintore di Tramonti、西班牙 Tintilla，也不是染色葡萄统称。

grapes.name: Piedirosso
grapes.origin: 深度关联 Napoli、Vesuvio、Ischia，也见于 Campania 其他地区。
grapes.summary: 重要芳香红葡萄，常较 Aglianico 单宁温和，单酿、混酿皆有。
grapes.viticulture: VCR 描述生长势强、枝条下垂、中早萌芽、中晚熟，适合适度长梢修剪；红果梗具特色。
grapes.winemaking: 酿单品种红、桃红及混酿，常配 Aglianico；萃取影响厚度。
grapes.taste: 花香、红果，或轻柔香料，有用酸度及相对适中单宁。
grapes.confusions: Per’ e Palummo 是地方名，不是独立 Ischia 品种。

grapes.name: Coda di Volpe Bianca
grapes.origin: Campania 传统白葡萄，名称来自弯曲果穗末端。
grapes.summary: 在 Irpinia、Sannio 既作单酿也作辅助葡萄。
grapes.viticulture: VCR 记录晚萌芽、中晚熟、适中生长势、大而紧或半紧穗；湿地有灰霉、酸腐风险。

grapes.confusions: 与 Caprettone、Pallagrello Bianco、Galluccio 保育 Coda di Pecora Bianca 不同。

grapes.name: Asprinio
grapes.origin: 核心在 Caserta、Napoli 北部 Aversa。
grapes.summary: 高酸白葡萄，关联静止、起泡及 alberata aversana。
grapes.viticulture: 传统藤攀活树，需高梯、熟练采收；也有现代低架。

grapes.taste: 干型、鲜明酸度、较克制香气，是南部白酒参照。
grapes.confusions: 不能自动将 Basilicata 保育 Asprinio di Ruoti 等同 Aversa 品种。

grapes.name: Biancolella
grapes.origin: 深植 Ischia，也有其他第勒尼安岛屿、海岸记录。

grapes.taste: Casa D’Ambra 对具体酒描述白果、花香、干型口感、杏仁式收尾。
grapes.confusions: 地区研究中 Biancolellone、Biancolella Riccia 材料谱并非完全一致，不盲并近名。

text.en: Terre del Volturno IGT explicitly permits the named varietal category, with at least 85% of the cultivar.
text.zh: Terre del Volturno IGT 明确设品种类别，至少 85% 该葡萄。

text.en: Dry red expressions with fruit and structural weight; extraction and maturation vary by producer.
text.zh: 干红果味及结构表现；萃取、熟成随酒庄而异。

text.en: Pallagrello Bianco and Nero are separate cultivar identities, not an assumed colour-mutation pair. Bianco is not Coda di Volpe.

intro.en: Adriatic central Italian region between mountains and coast, combining Montepulciano reds, Cerasuolo rosé and distinct white-grape traditions.
intro.zh: 亚得里亚海与山地间的意大利中部大区，融合 Montepulciano 红酒、Cerasuolo 桃红及不同白葡萄传统。

body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: An administrative region with numerous independent denominations.
body.zh: 行政大区，包含多个独立法定产区。

body.en: Montepulciano d’Abruzzo, Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo and Trebbiano d’Abruzzo are separate DOCs.
body.zh: Montepulciano d’Abruzzo、Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo、Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 为不同 DOC。

body.en: Montepulciano DOC dates to 1968; Trebbiano DOC to 1972.
body.zh: Montepulciano DOC 为 1968 年，Trebbiano DOC 为 1972 年。

body.en: Colline Teramane became DOCG in 2003; Cerasuolo obtained independent DOC status in 2010.
body.zh: Colline Teramane 于 2003 年成 DOCG，Cerasuolo 于 2010 年独立 DOC。

body.en: Gran Sasso and Majella are major inland reference points; the Adriatic lies east.
body.zh: Gran Sasso、Majella 为重要内陆参照，亚得里亚海在东侧。

body.en: Delimited wine zones occur in Teramo, Pescara, Chieti and L’Aquila.
body.zh: Teramo、Pescara、Chieti、L’Aquila 均有划定产酒区。

body.en: Mountain proximity promotes ventilation and diurnal variation; coastal and inland ripening conditions differ.
body.zh: 近山促进通风、昼夜温差，海岸与内陆成熟条件有别。

body.en: Teramo’s legal geographic account describes wetter autumn and a July rainfall minimum.
body.zh: Teramo 规范地理说明描述秋季较湿、七月降雨最低。

body.en: Clay-silt hills with looser coastal interlayers; not a uniform limestone landscape.
body.zh: 黏粉土丘陵夹沿海较疏松层，并非一致石灰岩地貌。

body.en: Terre Aquilane includes older fluvial-alluvial terraces with loose deposits and variable depth.
body.zh: Terre Aquilane 有较老河流冲积阶地、疏松沉积及不同深度。

body.en: The white DOC admits Trebbiano Abruzzese and/or Trebbiano Toscano as principal grapes.
body.zh: 白酒 DOC 主葡萄可为 Trebbiano Abruzzese 和／或 Trebbiano Toscano。

body.en: Cococciola centres on Chieti; Montonico on Bisenti/Cermignano; Pecorino and Passerina have named Abruzzo DOC categories.
body.zh: Cococciola 核心 Chieti，Montonico 核心 Bisenti／Cermignano；Pecorino、Passerina 有 Abruzzo DOC 类别。

body.en: Pergola abruzzese remains characteristic alongside modern trellised vineyards.
body.zh: Pergola abruzzese 仍具特色，也有现代棚架园。

body.en: Colline Teramane DOCG vineyards may not exceed 550 m; maximum grape yield is 9.5 t/ha.
body.zh: Colline Teramane DOCG 园不超过 550 米，葡萄最高 9.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Basic Montepulciano DOC minimum 85%; Colline Teramane minimum 90%, with Sangiovese up to 10%.
body.zh: 基础 Montepulciano DOC 至少 85%；Colline Teramane 至少 90%，Sangiovese 最多 10%。

body.en: Casauria now has independent DOCG registration; Tullum is another Abruzzo DOCG.
body.zh: Casauria 已独立登记 DOCG，Tullum 也是 Abruzzo DOCG。

body.en: Montepulciano supports both red wines and Cerasuolo rosé, with different extraction.
body.zh: Montepulciano 可酿红酒、Cerasuolo 桃红，萃取不同。

body.en: Abruzzo DOC includes a wider grape and sparkling range than Trebbiano d’Abruzzo alone.
body.zh: Abruzzo DOC 品种、起泡范围比单独 Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 更广。

body.en: Torano Nuovo estate documents separate Montepulciano, Trebbiano and Cerasuolo bottles; decanting practices are producer-specific.
body.zh: Torano Nuovo 酒庄分别记录三类酒；换瓶去沉淀为酒庄实践。

body.en: Compare Montepulciano red and Cerasuolo to separate grape identity from extraction; deeper pink does not prove sweetness.
body.zh: 比较红酒、Cerasuolo 区分品种与萃取，较深粉红不证明甜度。

q.en: Which sea borders Abruzzo’s eastern vineyards?
q.zh: Abruzzo 东部葡萄园临哪片海？

q.en: Which two mountain massifs are major influences on Abruzzo’s vineyard landscape?
q.zh: 哪两座山体显著影响 Abruzzo 葡萄园地貌？

q.en: Which grape defines Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC?
q.zh: 哪种葡萄定义 Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC？

q.en: What colour/style is Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo DOC?
q.zh: Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo DOC 属何酒色风格？

a.zh: 以 Montepulciano 为主的桃红。

q.en: Which two Trebbiano identities may supply the principal portion of Trebbiano d’Abruzzo?
q.zh: Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 主组成允许哪两种 Trebbiano？

q.en: Which Abruzzo province is particularly associated with Cococciola?
q.zh: Abruzzo 哪个省特别关联 Cococciola？

q.en: Which Teramo localities are core references for Montonico conservation?
q.zh: Teramo 哪些地方是 Montonico 保育核心？

q.en: In which province is Colline Teramane Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOCG?
q.zh: Colline Teramane Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOCG 位于哪省？

q.en: When did Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo become a separate DOC?
q.zh: Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo 何时成为独立 DOC？

q.en: In which Abruzzo commune is Emidio Pepe based?
q.zh: Emidio Pepe 位于 Abruzzo 哪个市镇？

q.en: What is the minimum Montepulciano share in the basic Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC blend?
q.zh: 基础 Montepulciano d’Abruzzo DOC 最低 Montepulciano 比例？

q.en: What is the minimum Montepulciano share for Colline Teramane DOCG?
q.zh: Colline Teramane DOCG 的最低 Montepulciano 比例？

q.en: Which grape may complete Colline Teramane’s blend, and to what maximum?
q.zh: Colline Teramane 允许哪种辅助葡萄，最高多少？

q.en: What is the combined minimum for Trebbiano Abruzzese and/or Trebbiano Toscano in basic Trebbiano d’Abruzzo?
q.zh: 基础 Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 两种 Trebbiano 合计最低多少？

q.en: Does Trebbiano d’Abruzzo on a label guarantee 100% Trebbiano Abruzzese?
q.zh: 酒标 Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 是否保证 100% Trebbiano Abruzzese？

a.en: No. Trebbiano Toscano and authorized complements are permitted under the blend rules.
a.zh: 否，配比规范允许 Trebbiano Toscano 及合资格辅助葡萄。

q.en: What is the current protected name order following the 2023 Colline Teramane amendment?
q.zh: 2023 修订后 Colline Teramane 受保护名词序是什么？

q.en: Which 2025 recognition makes an older claim of only two Abruzzo DOCGs obsolete?
q.zh: 2025 哪项认可使 Abruzzo 仅有两个 DOCG 的旧说法过时？

q.en: How should a historical Montepulciano d’Abruzzo Casauria label be catalogued after the new DOCG?
q.zh: 新 DOCG 设立后，历史 Montepulciano d’Abruzzo Casauria 酒标如何入库？

a.en: Retain the vintage’s original legal label; do not retroactively relabel every old bottle Casauria DOCG.
a.zh: 保留该年份原法定酒标，不把所有老瓶追溯改为 Casauria DOCG。

q.en: What is Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo’s minimum Montepulciano proportion?
q.zh: Cerasuolo d’Abruzzo 最低 Montepulciano 比例？

q.en: Name the four provincial Trebbiano d’Abruzzo subzones in the amended framework.
q.zh: 列出修订架构下四个省域 Trebbiano d’Abruzzo 子区。

a.en: Colline Pescaresi, Colline Teramane, Terre de L’Aquila and Terre di Chieti.
a.zh: Colline Pescaresi、Colline Teramane、Terre de L’Aquila、Terre di Chieti。

q.en: Why is a single coastal climate description insufficient for Abruzzo?
q.zh: 为何单一海岸气候不能概括 Abruzzo？

a.en: Altitude, inland distance and the Gran Sasso–Majella mountain system create substantial differences from the Adriatic coastal hills.
a.zh: 海拔、距海距离及 Gran Sasso—Majella 山系使内陆与亚得里亚海丘陵明显不同。

q.en: Which sedimentary soil materials recur in Abruzzo’s hilly appellation descriptions?
q.zh: Abruzzo 丘陵产区常见哪些沉积土壤物质？

a.en: Clay and marl, with proportions and texture varying by site.
a.zh: 黏土、泥灰岩，比例与质地因地块而异。

q.en: What is the pergola abruzzese?
q.zh: 什么是 pergola abruzzese？

a.en: A traditional overhead vine-training system associated with the region.
a.zh: 本区传统顶棚式葡萄架式。

q.en: Should Montonico be merged with Mantonico Bianco because the names resemble each other?
q.zh: Montonico 是否应因名称近似而并入 Mantonico Bianco？

a.en: No. They remain distinct identities in the library.

q.en: Which broader DOC provides named Cococciola and Montonico wines?
q.zh: 哪个较广 DOC 设 Cococciola、Montonico 标示品种酒？

q.en: Name two other important local white-grape labels in Abruzzo DOC.
q.zh: 再列两种 Abruzzo DOC 重要地方白葡萄标示。

q.en: What cellar distinction separates Montepulciano red from Cerasuolo rosé despite a shared main grape?
q.zh: 共享主要葡萄时，Montepulciano 红与 Cerasuolo 桃红有何酒窖差别？

a.en: Skin contact and extraction differ, producing different colour, tannin and structure.
a.zh: 浸皮与萃取不同，形成不同酒色、单宁及结构。

q.en: Does Cerasuolo’s relatively deep rosé colour prove sweetness?
q.zh: Cerasuolo 较深桃红色能否证明甜度高？

a.en: No. Colour does not determine residual sugar.

q.en: Are Emidio Pepe’s cellar methods mandatory rules for every Abruzzo producer?
q.zh: Emidio Pepe 酒窖方法是否强制适用于所有 Abruzzo 酒庄？

a.en: No. They are producer-specific practices, distinct from appellation requirements.
a.zh: 否，为酒庄实践，须与法定产区要求分开。

q.en: Besides Colline Teramane and Casauria, which named DOCG is in Abruzzo?
q.zh: 除 Colline Teramane、Casauria 外，Abruzzo 另有哪个 DOCG？

body.zh: Osco／Terre degli Osci、Rotae 为地区 IGT 参照。

body.zh: Biferno、Pentro 均于 1983 年认可。

body.en: Lower coastal settings have more maritime influence; Isernia hills provide a cooler inland context.
body.zh: 较低海岸地海洋影响更强，Isernia 丘陵为较凉内陆环境。

body.en: Drained calcareous hill soils occur in the Tintilia geographic account.
body.zh: Tintilia 地理说明含排水良好石灰质丘陵土。

body.en: Sandy-clayey coastal hills and piedmont alluvium add variation in texture and depth.
body.zh: 砂黏质海岸丘陵、山麓冲积物增加质地深度差异。

body.en: Tintilia is local; Montepulciano and Aglianico connect Molise to neighbouring regions.
body.zh: Tintilia 属地方特色，Montepulciano、Aglianico 连接邻区。

body.en: Pentro’s legal Falanghina wording alone does not determine Beneventana or Flegrea genotype.
body.zh: Pentro 法规 Falanghina 名称本身不能确定 Beneventana／Flegrea 基因型。

body.en: Loose bunches and thick skins coexist with unreliable fruit set and modest crops.
body.zh: 疏松穗、厚皮与坐果不稳定、低产并存。

body.en: Mildew risks remain despite rusticity; Tintilia DOC maximum yield is 8 t/ha.
body.zh: 适应力不等于无霉病风险；Tintilia DOC 最高 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Red/rosé: Montepulciano 70–80%, Aglianico 10–20%.
body.zh: 红／桃红 Montepulciano 70–80%、Aglianico 10–20%。

body.en: Current red/rosé: Montepulciano 75–80%, Tintilia 20–25%; obsolete Sangiovese summaries must not substitute for the law.
body.zh: 现红／桃红 Montepulciano 75–80%、Tintilia 20–25%，不用过时 Sangiovese 摘要取代法规。

body.en: Dedicated DOC requires at least 95% Tintilia.
body.zh: 专属 DOC 要求至少 95% Tintilia。

body.en: Rosso, Rosso Riserva and Rosato; Riserva needs two years from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: Rosso、Rosso Riserva、Rosato；Riserva 自采收年 11 月 1 日起两年。

body.en: Tintilia red/rosé maximum grape-to-wine yield 70%; Riserva 55%.
body.zh: Tintilia 红／桃红最高出酒率 70%，Riserva 55%。

body.en: Di Majo Norante documents 100% Tintilia; Claudio Cipressi is associated with recovery at San Felice del Molise.
body.zh: Di Majo Norante 记录 100% Tintilia；Claudio Cipressi 关联 San Felice del Molise 保育。

body.en: Assess acidity, phenolic grip and pepper/clove spice together; do not treat bottle alcohol as the DOC minimum.
body.zh: 同时看酸度、酚类收敛、胡椒丁香；不把瓶款酒精当 DOC 最低值。

role.zh: 已记录地方种植或保育。

q.en: What are Molise’s two provinces?
q.zh: Molise 两个省是什么？

q.en: Name Molise’s four DOC denominations in this framework.
q.zh: 列出本架构中 Molise 四个 DOC。

a.en: Biferno, Molise, Pentro di Isernia and Tintilia del Molise.

q.en: Which recovered local red grape is a key Molise identity?
q.zh: 哪种复兴地方红葡萄是 Molise 重要身份？

q.en: When was Tintilia del Molise DOC recognized?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise DOC 何时认可？

q.en: Which province contains Biferno DOC’s production area?
q.zh: Biferno DOC 产区位于哪个省？

q.en: Which province contains Pentro di Isernia DOC?
q.zh: Pentro di Isernia DOC 位于哪个省？

q.en: What are Tintilia del Molise’s three main wine types?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise 三种主要酒型是什么？

q.en: What is the minimum Tintilia content in Tintilia del Molise DOC?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise DOC 最低 Tintilia 含量？

q.en: Name a producer with an officially documented 100% Tintilia wine.
q.zh: 列一个官方资料注明 100% Tintilia 酒款的酒庄。

q.en: Which spice notes are useful references for Tintilia?
q.zh: Tintilia 可参照哪些香料气息？

a.en: Pepper and clove, alongside fruit and structure.
a.zh: 胡椒、丁香，并结合果香与结构。

q.en: What is the minimum elevation for Tintilia del Molise vineyards?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise 葡萄园最低海拔？

q.en: What is Tintilia del Molise’s maximum grape yield?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise 葡萄最高产量？

q.en: What is the maximum grape-to-wine conversion for Tintilia Riserva?
q.zh: Tintilia Riserva 最高出酒率？

q.en: What is the maximum conversion for ordinary Tintilia Rosso and Rosato?
q.zh: 普通 Tintilia Rosso、Rosato 最高出酒率？

q.en: Give the main Biferno red/rosé proportions.
q.zh: Biferno 红桃红主要配比是什么？

q.en: Which grape forms 70–80% of Biferno Bianco?
q.zh: Biferno Bianco 哪种葡萄占 70–80%？

q.en: What are the modern Pentro red/rosé principal proportions?
q.zh: 现代 Pentro 红桃红主要配比是什么？

q.en: Why should an old Sangiovese-led Pentro summary not be copied as the current rule?
q.zh: 为何不能把旧 Sangiovese 主导 Pentro 摘要复制为现行规则？

a.en: The 2014 consolidated specification uses Montepulciano and Tintilia and provided a vineyard transition period.
a.zh: 2014 汇总规范改用 Montepulciano、Tintilia，并设葡萄园过渡期。

q.en: From what date did Pentro’s ten-year vineyard adaptation period run?
q.zh: Pentro 十年葡萄园调整期从何日开始？

q.en: What is the specified Falanghina share of Pentro Bianco?
q.zh: Pentro Bianco 指定 Falanghina 比例？

q.en: What is Trebbiano Toscano’s range in Pentro Bianco?
q.zh: Pentro Bianco 的 Trebbiano Toscano 比例范围？

q.en: Does the legal name Falanghina alone establish the Beneventana or Flegrea genotype?
q.zh: 法规单写 Falanghina 是否足以确认 Beneventana 或 Flegrea 基因型？

a.en: No. The cultivar identity requires more specific evidence.
a.zh: 否，品种身份需更具体证据。

q.en: Which soil materials recur in Tintilia del Molise’s hill environment?
q.zh: Tintilia del Molise 丘陵环境常见什么土壤物质？

a.en: Calcareous materials with sandy and clay components, varying by site.
a.zh: 钙质母质与砂、黏土组成，随地块变化。

q.en: Which reproductive issue can limit Tintilia yields?
q.zh: Tintilia 哪项结实问题可能限制产量？

a.en: Irregular fruit set and small/uneven berries can reduce production.
a.zh: 坐果不稳及小粒、不均匀果粒可能减产。

q.en: Should Tintilia’s local adaptation be described as immunity to fungal disease?
q.zh: Tintilia 地方适应性是否应写成免疫真菌病害？

a.en: No. Adaptation does not establish immunity; disease response needs specific evidence.
a.zh: 否，适应性不等于免疫，抗病表现需具体证据。

q.en: Which early nineteenth-century author is cited in Tintilia’s Molise documentation?
q.zh: Tintilia Molise 文献引用哪位十九世纪初作者？

q.en: Which commune is associated with Claudio Cipressi’s Tintilia recovery work?
q.zh: Claudio Cipressi Tintilia 保育工作关联哪个市镇？

q.en: Does Di Majo Norante’s 100% Tintilia recipe mean the DOC requires 100%?
q.zh: Di Majo Norante 的 100% Tintilia 是否表示 DOC 强制 100%？

a.en: No. The DOC minimum is 95%; the producer chooses 100%.

q.en: What structural traits should be assessed alongside Tintilia’s spice?
q.zh: 除 Tintilia 香料外须评估何种结构？

a.en: Acidity, phenolic grip and tannin balance.
a.zh: 酸度、酚类收敛及单宁平衡。

q.en: Which two Molise IGT names complement the DOC framework?
q.zh: 哪两个 Molise IGT 名补充 DOC 架构？

a.en: Osco or Terre degli Osci, and Rotae.
a.zh: Osco 或 Terre degli Osci，以及 Rotae。

intro.en: Tyrrhenian region combining inland Irpinia and Sannio, volcanic Naples, islands, Caserta and the Amalfi coast. Local cultivar identities are fundamental.
intro.zh: 第勒尼安大区，兼有 Irpinia、Sannio 内陆，Napoli 火山区、岛屿、Caserta、Amalfi 海岸，地方品种精确身份至关重要。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Avellino, Benevento, Caserta, Napoli and Salerno form distinct wine landscapes.
body.zh: Avellino、Benevento、Caserta、Napoli、Salerno 各有不同葡萄酒地貌。

body.en: Taurasi, Greco di Tufo, Fiano di Avellino and Aglianico del Taburno are the four DOCG references.
body.zh: 四个 DOCG 参照为 Taurasi、Greco di Tufo、Fiano di Avellino、Aglianico del Taburno。

body.en: Regional work distinguishes Roviello/Greco Musc’ from Greco and identifies sampled Cascolo as Sciascinoso.
body.zh: 地区研究将 Roviello／Greco Musc’ 与 Greco 区分，所测 Cascolo 鉴为 Sciascinoso。

body.en: Caprettone separately registered in 2014; Uva del Conte entered the regional list in February 2026.
body.zh: Caprettone 2014 独立登记，Uva del Conte 2026 二月进入地区名录。

body.en: Irpinia surrounds Avellino’s valleys and hills; Sannio centres on Benevento.
body.zh: Irpinia 关联 Avellino 河谷丘陵，Sannio 核心 Benevento。

body.en: Campi Flegrei is near Naples, Ischia is an island DOC, and Amalfi includes Furore, Ravello and Tramonti.
body.zh: Campi Flegrei 近 Napoli，Ischia 为岛屿 DOC，Amalfi 含 Furore、Ravello、Tramonti。

body.en: Inland Aglianico’s long cycle can extend to late October–November; altitude and exposure affect ripening.
body.zh: 内陆 Aglianico 长周期可至十月末、十一月；海拔坡向影响成熟。

body.en: Campi Flegrei has tuff, ash, pumice and lapilli; some sandy sites retain ungrafted vines.
body.zh: Campi Flegrei 有凝灰岩、灰、浮石、火山砾，部分砂地留自根藤。

body.en: Irpinia also has clay, marl and limestone; Fiorduva sites are described as dolomitic limestone.
body.zh: Irpinia 也有黏土、泥灰、石灰岩；Fiorduva 地块为白云质石灰岩。

body.en: Coda di Volpe, Caprettone and Pallagrello Bianco are separate; Camaiola is distinct from Piedmont Barbera.
body.zh: Coda di Volpe、Caprettone、Pallagrello Bianco 独立；Camaiola 非 Piemonte Barbera。

body.en: Biancolella and Forastera anchor Ischia whites; Per’ e Palummo is Piedirosso.
body.zh: Biancolella、Forastera 主导 Ischia 白酒；Per’ e Palummo 即 Piedirosso。

body.en: Asprinio climbs living tree supports in alberata aversana, requiring tall ladders and skilled harvesting.
body.zh: Asprinio 以 alberata aversana 攀活树，需高梯、熟练采收。

body.en: Regional cultivar registration does not automatically authorize every PDO blend.
body.zh: 地区品种登记不自动授权所有 PDO 配比。

body.en: Aglianico minimum 85%; three years including one in wood, Riserva four including 18 months wood; clock starts 1 December of harvest year.
body.zh: Aglianico 至少 85%；三年含一年木桶，Riserva 四年含十八月木桶；采收年 12 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Traditional-method sparkling categories received final EU amendment approval in June 2025, following the earlier proposal.
body.zh: 传统法起泡类别在早前提案后于 2025 六月获最终欧盟修订批准。

body.en: Named Caprettone, Falanghina, Piedirosso and Aglianico categories each require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: Caprettone、Falanghina、Piedirosso、Aglianico 专名各至少 85% 对应葡萄。

body.en: Traditional-method bottle refermentation: minimum 18 months on lees, 36 for Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: 传统法瓶中再发酵，酒泥至少 18 月，Spumante Riserva 36 月。

body.en: Fenile 30%, Ginestra 30%, Ripoli 40%; late-picked barrel-fermented dry white.
body.zh: Fenile 30%、Ginestra 30%、Ripoli 40%；晚采桶发酵干白。

body.en: Mastroberardino Radici, Casa D’Ambra’s island wines and Vestini Campagnano’s recovered varieties supply different benchmarks.
body.zh: Mastroberardino Radici、Casa D’Ambra 岛酒、Vestini Campagnano 保育葡萄提供不同参照。

body.en: Compare fragrant, often less tannic Piedirosso with structured Aglianico, then assess vintage and extraction.
body.zh: 对比芳香常较温和 Piedirosso 与结构型 Aglianico，再评年份萃取。

q.en: Name Campania’s five provinces/metropolitan areas.
q.zh: 列出 Campania 五个省／都会区。

a.en: Avellino, Benevento, Caserta, Naples and Salerno.

q.en: Which grape is the principal component of Taurasi?
q.zh: Taurasi 主要葡萄是什么？

q.en: Which grape defines Greco di Tufo?
q.zh: 哪种葡萄定义 Greco di Tufo？

q.en: Which grape defines Fiano di Avellino?
q.zh: 哪种葡萄定义 Fiano di Avellino？

q.zh: Falanghina del Sannio DOC 位于哪省？

q.zh: 列出 Costa d’Amalfi 三个子区。

q.en: Who produces Furore Bianco Fiorduva?
q.zh: 谁酿造 Furore Bianco Fiorduva？

q.en: What is Taurasi’s minimum Aglianico share?
q.zh: Taurasi 最低 Aglianico 比例？

q.en: What is standard Taurasi’s compulsory maturation, and when does the clock start?
q.zh: 普通 Taurasi 法定熟成多久，何时起算？

a.en: Three years including one year wood, from 1 December of harvest year.
a.zh: 三年含一年木桶，自采收年 12 月 1 日起算。

q.en: What is Taurasi Riserva’s compulsory maturation?
q.zh: Taurasi Riserva 法定熟成多久？

a.en: Four years including eighteen months wood.

q.en: Which grape may form up to 15% of Greco di Tufo?
q.zh: 哪种葡萄可占 Greco di Tufo 最多 15%？

q.en: How many communes comprise Greco di Tufo’s zone?
q.zh: Greco di Tufo 产区含多少市镇？

q.en: Which river is central to Greco di Tufo’s geography?
q.zh: Greco di Tufo 地理核心河流是什么？

q.en: What is still Greco di Tufo Riserva’s minimum ageing period and start date?
q.zh: 静止 Greco di Tufo Riserva 最低熟成与起算日？

a.en: Twelve months from 1 November of harvest year.
a.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起十二个月。

q.en: Can Greco di Tufo Spumante use tank fermentation under the approved specification?
q.zh: 获准规范下 Greco di Tufo Spumante 可否罐式二发？

a.en: No. Traditional bottle fermentation is required.
a.zh: 不可，必须传统瓶中二发。

q.en: What are the minimum lees periods for Greco di Tufo Spumante and Spumante Riserva?
q.zh: Greco di Tufo Spumante、Spumante Riserva 最低酒泥陈年多久？

a.en: Eighteen and thirty-six months respectively, from tirage.
a.zh: 自装瓶二发起分别十八、三十六个月。

q.en: When was the EU amendment adding Fiano di Avellino’s sparkling framework approved?
q.zh: 增加 Fiano di Avellino 起泡架构的欧盟修订何时批准？

a.en: June 2025, not the earlier proposal year.
a.zh: 2025 年 6 月，不是较早提案年份。

q.en: Should Caprettone be catalogued as Coda di Volpe?
q.zh: Caprettone 是否应归作 Coda di Volpe？

a.en: No. Caprettone has a separate register identity.
a.zh: 否，Caprettone 有独立登记身份。

q.en: Which cultivar identity is associated with Greco Musc’, and is it ordinary Greco?
q.zh: Greco Musc’ 关联哪个品种，是否普通 Greco？

a.en: Roviello; it is distinct from Greco.

q.en: Is the Sannio grape now registered as Camaiola the same as Piemonte Barbera?
q.zh: Sannio 现登记为 Camaiola 的葡萄是否 Piemonte Barbera？

a.en: No. Historical Barbera del Sannio usage must not collapse it with Barbera.
a.zh: 否，历史 Barbera del Sannio 用名不可导致与 Barbera 合并。

q.en: What is Fiorduva’s stated three-grape blend?
q.zh: Fiorduva 注明的三葡萄配比？

q.en: What geology and elevation does Marisa Cuomo report for Fiorduva sites?
q.zh: Marisa Cuomo 注明 Fiorduva 地块何种地质与海拔？

a.zh: 白云质石灰岩，海拔 200–550 米。

q.en: Which volcanic materials are relevant to Campi Flegrei soils?
q.zh: Campi Flegrei 土壤关联哪些火山物质？

a.zh: 凝灰岩、火山灰、浮石、火山砾。

q.en: Does regional grape authorization automatically authorize a named varietal in every DOC?
q.zh: 大区允许栽培是否自动允许在所有 DOC 标示该品种？

a.en: No. Each denomination’s own specification controls its grape composition and named types.
a.zh: 否，各法定区规范单独控制配比与品种类型。

q.en: Which two areas supply Mastroberardino’s Radici Taurasi?
q.zh: Mastroberardino Radici Taurasi 来自哪两个地方？

q.en: Name Falanghina del Sannio’s four subzones.
q.zh: 列出 Falanghina del Sannio 四个子区。

a.en: Guardia Sanframondi/Guardiolo, Sant’Agata dei Goti, Solopaca and Taburno.

q.en: How does Piedirosso commonly compare structurally with Aglianico?
q.zh: Piedirosso 与 Aglianico 通常有何结构差别？

a.en: Piedirosso commonly has a lighter tannic frame; blend, site and extraction still matter.
a.zh: Piedirosso 单宁结构通常更轻，仍须考虑配比、地块与萃取。

coverage.en: Primary-source regional overview and selected linked denominations; this is not an exhaustive inventory of every authorized grape or wine designation.
coverage.zh: 依据一手资料的区域概览与精选关联产区，非所有获准葡萄或葡萄酒名称的穷尽清单。

intro.en: Southern region whose vineyards span Vulture’s Aglianico, warmer Matera, inland Alta Val d’Agri and heritage-grape recovery around Pollino.
intro.zh: 南部大区，涵盖 Vulture Aglianico、较暖 Matera、内陆 Alta Val d’Agri 及 Pollino 传统葡萄保育。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Vulture DOC and Superiore DOCG are separate; Matera, Grottino di Roccanova and Terre dell’Alta Val d’Agri broaden the regional picture.
body.zh: Vulture DOC、Superiore DOCG 独立；另有 Matera、Grottino di Roccanova、Terre dell’Alta Val d’Agri。

body.en: Vulture is one northern zone, not a proxy for all Basilicata climates or soils.
body.zh: Vulture 只是北部一区，不能代表全 Basilicata 气候土壤。

body.en: Vulture DOC dates to 1971; Superiore DOCG to 2010.
body.zh: Vulture DOC 始于 1971，Superiore DOCG 为 2010。

body.en: ALSIA investigates old local accessions; names and later registrations need genetic reconciliation.
body.zh: ALSIA 调查老地方材料；名称、后续登记需遗传核对。

body.en: Vulture vineyards lie in Potenza province around an extinct volcano, with a 200–700 m legal vineyard band.
body.zh: Vulture 园在 Potenza 省死火山周边，法定海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Matera has Ionian coastal and hill settings; Alta Val d’Agri centres on Viggiano, Grumento Nova and Moliterno; Guarnaccino on Chiaromonte.
body.zh: Matera 有爱奥尼亚海岸丘陵；Alta Val d’Agri 核心三个市镇；Guarnaccino 核心 Chiaromonte。

body.en: Dry summers precede wetter October–November, when late Aglianico may still be harvested.
body.zh: 旱夏后十至十一月较湿，晚熟 Aglianico 仍可能采收。

body.en: Ionian–Metapontine and Bradano areas are among the region’s warmest, with marked summer drought.
body.zh: Ionian–Metapontine、Bradano 为地区最暖区之一，夏旱明显。

body.en: Volcanic and sedimentary deposits alternate; tuff supports summer water storage.
body.zh: 火山、沉积材料交替，凝灰岩有助夏季蓄水。

body.en: Coastal plains, marine terraces and Bradanic hills include calcareous sands and conglomerates.
body.zh: 海岸平原、海成阶地、Bradanic 丘陵含石灰质砂及砾岩。

body.en: Aglianico is central to Vulture; Guarnaccino has documented Chiaromonte red and rosé bottlings.
body.zh: Aglianico 核心 Vulture；Guarnaccino 有 Chiaromonte 红、桃红装瓶。

body.en: Merlot/Cabernet Sauvignon dominate Alta Val d’Agri reds; Matera also uses Sangiovese, Primitivo and Greco.

body.en: Traditional alberello and simple trellises are permitted in Vulture.
body.zh: Vulture 允许传统 alberello、简单棚架。

body.en: Vulture DOC maximum 10 t/ha; Superiore DOCG 8 t/ha.
body.zh: Vulture DOC 最高 10 吨／公顷，Superiore DOCG 8 吨／公顷。

body.en: Superiore starts 1 November in the third year after harvest, with 12 months wood/12 bottle; Riserva fifth year with 24 wood/12 bottle.
body.zh: Superiore 采收后第三年 11 月 1 日起，12 月木桶／12 月瓶陈；Riserva 第五年、24／12 月。

body.en: Rosso minimum Sangiovese 60%/Primitivo 30%; Moro minimum Cabernet Sauvignon 60%/Primitivo 20%/Merlot 10%.
body.zh: Rosso 至少 Sangiovese 60%／Primitivo 30%；Moro 至少 Cabernet Sauvignon 60%／Primitivo 20%／Merlot 10%。

body.en: The DOC includes red sparkling with bottle refermentation and at least nine months processing.
body.zh: DOC 含瓶中再发酵红起泡，制作至少九个月。

body.en: Superiore and Riserva are still red categories; the DOC’s sparkling type does not transfer automatically.
body.zh: Superiore、Riserva 为静止红类别，DOC 起泡不自动转入。

body.en: Paternoster Don Anselmo currently carries Superiore DOCG; 600 Grotte documents Il Nero, Nostos and Rhodalys from Guarnaccino.
body.zh: Paternoster Don Anselmo 当前 Superiore DOCG；600 Grotte 有 Guarnaccino 的 Il Nero、Nostos、Rhodalys。

body.en: White and red use different principal varieties; red and rosé share grapes but differ in extraction.

intro.zh: Isernia DOC，现代红酒以 Montepulciano—Tintilia 配比为核心。

body.zh: 1983 认可 DOC。

body.en: The 2014 specification allowed old vineyards ten years from 1 August 2014 to adapt.
body.zh: 2014 规范给予旧园自 2014 年 8 月 1 日起十年调整。

body.en: Listed hill communes in Isernia province.
body.zh: Isernia 省指定丘陵市镇。

body.en: Montepulciano 75–80%, Tintilia 20–25%, eligible red complement up to 5%.
body.zh: Montepulciano 75–80%、Tintilia 20–25%，合资格红辅助最多 5%。

body.en: Falanghina 80%, Trebbiano Toscano 15–20%, other eligible whites up to 5%.
body.zh: Falanghina 80%、Trebbiano Toscano 15–20%，其他最多 5%。

body.en: Pentro is an authorized shortened name; old Sangiovese-based summaries are obsolete.
body.zh: Pentro 为获准简称，旧 Sangiovese 核心摘要过时。

body.en: One year from 1 November of harvest year, including six months oak.
body.zh: 采收年 11 月 1 日起一年，其中六月橡木。

body.en: The text requires four years including two years oak followed by six months bottle; its separate earliest-release clause conflicts and needs control-body clarification.
body.zh: 文本要求四年含两年橡木再六月瓶陈，另条最早上市日期有冲突，须控制机构澄清。

body.en: Dry, fresh white with minimum legal total acidity 6 g/L.
body.zh: 干型清新白酒，法定总酸最低 6 g/L。

body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC on 26 March 1970; DOCG on 11 March 1993.
body.zh: 1970 年 3 月 26 日认可 DOC，1993 年 3 月 11 日升级 DOCG。

body.en: The approved October 2020 text consolidates Taurasi and Taurasi Riserva rules.
body.zh: 2020 年 10 月批准文本汇总 Taurasi 与 Taurasi Riserva 规范。

body.en: Seventeen whole communes in Avellino province, including Taurasi, Montemarano, Castelfranci, Paternopoli and Mirabella Eclano.
body.zh: 涵盖 Avellino 省 17 个完整市镇，包括 Taurasi、Montemarano、Castelfranci、Paternopoli、Mirabella Eclano。

body.en: Bonito, Castelvetere sul Calore, Fontanarosa, Lapio, Luogosano, Montefalcione, Montemiletto, Pietradefusi, Sant’Angelo all’Esca, San Mango sul Calore, Torre le Nocelle and Venticano complete the zone.
body.zh: 其余为 Bonito、Castelvetere sul Calore、Fontanarosa、Lapio、Luogosano、Montefalcione、Montemiletto、Pietradefusi、Sant’Angelo all’Esca、San Mango sul Calore、Torre le Nocelle、Venticano。

body.en: Clay-rich sites and lighter sandy-loam sites coexist. Radici distinguishes clay at Montemarano from sandy loam at Mirabella Eclano; the denomination is not one uniform soil type.
body.zh: 富黏土与较轻砂质壤土并存。Radici 区分 Montemarano 黏土与 Mirabella Eclano 砂质壤土，整个法定区并非单一土质。

body.en: Aglianico at least 85%; other authorized non-aromatic red varieties from Avellino province up to 15%.
body.zh: Aglianico 至少 85%；Avellino 省其他获准非芳香红葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Insufficiently sunny or humid valley-floor sites are excluded. Emergency irrigation is permitted.
body.zh: 排除日照不足或潮湿谷底地块，允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 葡萄最高产量 10 t/ha。

body.en: Minimum natural potential alcohol: 11.5% for Taurasi and 12% for Riserva grapes.
body.zh: 葡萄最低自然潜在酒精度：Taurasi 11.5%，Riserva 12%。

body.en: Taurasi and Taurasi Riserva are dry red DOCG wines within the same protected denomination.
body.zh: Taurasi 与 Taurasi Riserva 均为同一保护名称下的干红 DOCG。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12% for Taurasi, 12.5% for Riserva; minimum total acidity 5 g/L for both.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 Taurasi 12%、Riserva 12.5%；两者总酸最低 5 g/L。

body.en: The vineyard name must be registered, with separate vinification and storage and matching records.
body.zh: 葡萄园名称须登记；酿造、储存及相关记录须分开。

body.en: At least three years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少三年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: At least four years, including eighteen months in wood.
body.zh: 至少四年，其中十八个月木桶。

body.en: Mandatory ageing begins on 1 December of the harvest year.
body.zh: 法定熟成自采收年 12 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Maximum grape-to-wine conversion 70% at first racking and 65% after compulsory ageing.
body.zh: 首次倒罐最高出酒率 70%，法定熟成后 65%。

body.en: Mastroberardino uses 100% Aglianico from Montemarano and Mirabella Eclano; the producer reports 24 months wood and 24 months bottle ageing.
body.zh: Mastroberardino 采用 Montemarano、Mirabella Eclano 的 100% Aglianico；酒庄注明 24 个月木桶及 24 个月瓶陈。

body.en: Radici vineyards average about 450 m, spur-pruned cordon, around 4,000 vines/ha and 5 t/ha; harvest is late October to early November. These are producer choices.
body.zh: Radici 葡萄园平均约 450 米，短梢修剪单臂蔓，约 4,000 株/ha、5 t/ha，10 月下旬至 11 月初采收；均为酒庄实践。

body.en: A 16–18°C starting point suits mature reds; assess sediment and tannin before decanting. Roasted red meat, game and aged hard cheese are reference pairings.
body.zh: 成熟红酒可从 16–18°C 起侍，依据沉淀与单宁决定醒酒；烤红肉、野味、熟成硬奶酪可作配餐参照。

role.en: At least 85%; structure and late ripening define the appellation.
role.zh: 至少 85%，结构与晚熟为产区核心。

note.en: 100% Aglianico; producer-specific vineyard and ageing details.
note.zh: 100% Aglianico；葡萄园及熟成资料为酒庄特定实践。

intro.en: Greco-led still and traditional-method sparkling DOCG in the Sabato valley of Irpinia.
intro.zh: Irpinia Sabato 河谷，以 Greco 为主的静止及传统法起泡 DOCG。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC recognized in 1970; DOCG in 2003.
body.zh: 1970 年认可 DOC，2003 年升级 DOCG。

body.en: Tufo, Altavilla Irpina, Chianche, Montefusco, Prata di Principato Ultra, Petruro Irpino, Santa Paolina and Torrioni, all in Avellino province.
body.zh: Tufo、Altavilla Irpina、Chianche、Montefusco、Prata di Principato Ultra、Petruro Irpino、Santa Paolina、Torrioni，均位于 Avellino 省。

body.en: The Sabato river and surrounding hills organize the production area.
body.zh: Sabato 河及周边丘陵构成产区地理骨架。

body.en: Clay-calcareous materials and volcanic contributions vary across the hills; the place-name alone does not establish identical tuff soils everywhere.
body.zh: 丘陵中黏土石灰质母质与火山物质影响各异；地名本身不能证明所有地块都是相同凝灰岩土。

body.en: Greco at least 85%; Coda di Volpe Bianca may supply up to 15%.
body.zh: Greco 至少 85%；Coda di Volpe Bianca 可占最多 15%。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 葡萄最高产量 10 t/ha。

body.en: Still Greco di Tufo, still Riserva, Spumante and Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: 静止 Greco di Tufo、静止 Riserva、Spumante、Spumante Riserva。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 11.5% for standard wine and 12% for Riserva; minimum total acidity 5 g/L.
body.zh: 标准酒最低总酒精度 11.5%，Riserva 12%；总酸最低 5 g/L。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12% and total acidity 6 g/L for the sparkling categories.
body.zh: 起泡类型最低总酒精度 12%，总酸 6 g/L。

body.en: At least twelve months of ageing from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月熟成。

body.en: Bottle fermentation by the traditional method is compulsory; tank fermentation is not the approved alternative.
body.zh: 必须传统瓶中二次发酵，罐式法不是获准替代方法。

body.en: At least eighteen months from tirage for Spumante, thirty-six months for Spumante Riserva.
body.zh: Spumante 自装瓶二发起至少十八个月；Spumante Riserva 三十六个月。

body.en: Compare still and sparkling wines separately: acidity is shared, while pressure, lees development and texture distinguish the styles.
body.zh: 静止与起泡应分别比较：均重视酸度，但气压、酒泥发展与质地不同。

intro.en: Fiano-centred Irpinia DOCG, with still wines and traditional-method sparkling categories approved in 2025.
intro.zh: 以 Fiano 为核心的 Irpinia DOCG，含静止酒及 2025 年批准的传统法起泡类型。

body.en: DOCG / PDO
body.zh: DOCG / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC in 1978 and DOCG in 2003.
body.zh: 1978 年 DOC，2003 年 DOCG。

body.en: Regulation 2025/1086 approved the Union amendment in June 2025; the earlier proposal date is not the approval date.
body.zh: 欧盟 2025/1086 号法规于 2025 年 6 月批准修订；较早提案日期不是批准日期。

body.en: Twenty-six communes in Avellino province, with contrasting altitude and exposure across inland Irpinia.
body.zh: Avellino 省二十六个市镇，Irpinia 内陆不同海拔、坡向形成差异。

body.en: Cold winters, spring frost risk, pronounced summer day–night variation and predominantly autumn/winter rainfall distinguish the inland hills.
body.zh: 寒冷冬季、春霜风险、明显夏季昼夜温差及秋冬为主降雨，构成内陆丘陵特征。

body.en: Ash and pumice deposits overlie clays or marls in parts of the area; sandstone, limestone, alluvial and detrital formations also occur.
body.zh: 部分地带灰、浮石覆盖黏土或泥灰岩；另有砂岩、石灰岩、冲积及碎屑层。

body.en: Fiano at least 85%.
body.zh: Fiano 至少 85%。

body.en: Greco, Coda di Volpe Bianca and Trebbiano Toscano may make up the permitted balance, collectively up to 15%.
body.zh: Greco、Coda di Volpe Bianca、Trebbiano Toscano 可合计占其余最多 15%。

body.en: New and replanted vineyards require vertical training and at least 2,500 vines/ha; maximum grape yield is 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 新植、重植园须垂直架式、至少 2,500 株/ha；葡萄最高 10 t/ha。

body.en: Well-exposed hills are eligible; humid or poorly sunny valley floors are excluded. Emergency irrigation is allowed.
body.zh: 允许朝向良好丘陵，排除潮湿或日照不足谷底；允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Still Fiano di Avellino and Riserva, plus Spumante Metodo Classico and Spumante Metodo Classico Riserva under the approved amendment.
body.zh: 静止 Fiano di Avellino、Riserva，以及批准修订后的 Spumante Metodo Classico、Spumante Metodo Classico Riserva。

body.en: Still wine requires total acidity at least 5 g/L and alcohol 11.5%, or 12% for Riserva. Sparkling requires acidity 6 g/L and alcohol 12%.
body.zh: 静止总酸至少 5 g/L、总酒精度 11.5%，Riserva 12%；起泡总酸 6 g/L、总酒精度 12%。

body.en: The traditional mention Apianum is permitted; it does not replace the protected denomination.
body.zh: 允许传统标示 Apianum，但不可取代受保护产区名。

body.en: The new categories use bottle fermentation by the traditional method, creating a different maturation framework from the still wine.
body.zh: 新增类型采用传统瓶中二次发酵，与静止酒有不同熟成框架。

body.en: Still Fiano can develop texture and bottle complexity; producer decisions on lees and vessels should be recorded bottle by bottle.
body.zh: 静止 Fiano 可发展质地与瓶陈复杂度；酒泥及容器选择须逐款记录酒庄资料。

body.en: At least twelve months from 1 November of harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月。

body.en: Bottle fermentation only; Spumante requires at least eighteen months from tirage, Spumante Riserva thirty-six months.
body.zh: 仅瓶中二发；Spumante 自装瓶二发起至少十八个月，Spumante Riserva 三十六个月。

body.en: Assess acidity, texture and development separately from oak influence; richer mature examples suit fuller dishes than youthful light styles.
body.zh: 酸度、质地、发展与橡木影响分开判断；饱满成熟酒款适合比清新年轻款更浓郁的菜肴。

body.zh: 2011 年 9 月 30 日成为独立 DOC。

body.en: The production zone lies in Benevento province.
body.zh: 产区位于 Benevento 省。

body.en: Guardia Sanframondi or Guardiolo, Sant’Agata dei Goti, Solopaca and Taburno.
body.zh: Guardia Sanframondi 或 Guardiolo、Sant’Agata dei Goti、Solopaca、Taburno。

body.en: Falanghina at least 85%; other eligible non-aromatic Benevento white grapes up to 15%.
body.zh: Falanghina 至少 85%；Benevento 其他合资格非芳香白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Falanghina Beneventana is the key inland reference. A legal mention of Falanghina alone should not be used to collapse it with Falanghina Flegrea.
body.zh: 内陆主要参照为 Falanghina Beneventana；法规单写 Falanghina 不应成为合并 Falanghina Flegrea 的依据。

body.en: Still white, Vendemmia Tardiva and Passito are separate authorized types.
body.zh: 静止白、Vendemmia Tardiva、Passito 是分别获准的类型。

body.en: Spumante, Spumante di Qualità and Spumante di Qualità Metodo Classico.
body.zh: Spumante、Spumante di Qualità、Spumante di Qualità Metodo Classico。

body.en: Tank fermentation is allowed for the ordinary and quality sparkling categories; Metodo Classico uses bottle fermentation.
body.zh: 普通及优质起泡类别允许罐式二发；Metodo Classico 使用瓶中二发。

body.en: Late harvest and dried-grape production create distinct concentration paths and must retain their specific category rules.
body.zh: 晚收及干化葡萄是不同浓缩路径，须保留各类型独立规范。

body.en: Assess still wine, sparkling wine and concentrated styles in separate flights, with sweetness and acidity considered together.
body.zh: 静止、起泡、浓缩风格分别品鉴，甜度与酸度结合判断。

role.en: Principal Sannio identity; legal Falanghina minimum 85%.
role.zh: Sannio 主要身份；法规 Falanghina 至少 85%。

body.en: The Phlegraean area west of Naples combines coastal exposure, hills and volcanic craters.
body.zh: Napoli 西侧 Phlegraean 地带结合海岸、丘陵与火山口。

body.en: Tuff, ash, pumice and lapilli contribute to variable, often loose soils; selected sandy sites sustain ungrafted vines.
body.zh: 凝灰岩、火山灰、浮石及火山砾形成不同、常疏松土壤，部分砂质地块保留自根藤。

body.en: Falanghina 50–70%; eligible white complements within the permitted balance.
body.zh: Falanghina 50–70%，其余合资格白葡萄按余量规范。

body.en: Piedirosso at least 50%, Aglianico at least 30%, other eligible red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Piedirosso 至少 50%，Aglianico 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Named Falanghina and Piedirosso wines require at least 90% of the named grape. Falanghina Flegrea is the local identity reference.
body.zh: 标示 Falanghina 或 Piedirosso 至少含所标葡萄 90%；当地 Falanghina 身份参照为 Falanghina Flegrea。

body.en: Bianco and Rosso coexist with varietal wines, Piedirosso Riserva, Rosato and Passito, and Falanghina Spumante and Passito.
body.zh: 含 Bianco、Rosso、品种酒、Piedirosso Riserva、Rosato、Passito，以及 Falanghina Spumante、Passito。

body.en: Red extraction, rosé production, dried-grape wines and sparkling fermentation create distinct profiles from the same local grape base.
body.zh: 红酒萃取、桃红、干化葡萄与起泡发酵，使相同地方葡萄形成不同酒型。

body.en: Piedirosso commonly shows a lighter tannic frame than Aglianico; blend composition and extraction must inform comparisons.
body.zh: Piedirosso 单宁结构通常比 Aglianico 轻，比较时须纳入配比与萃取。

role.en: Local white reference; legal Falanghina blend rules apply.
role.zh: 地方白葡萄参照，适用法规 Falanghina 配比。

role.en: Principal red grape and named varietal.
role.zh: 主要红葡萄及标示品种。

intro.en: Island DOC off Naples, with distinctive Biancolella–Forastera white blends and local red varieties.
intro.zh: Napoli 外海岛屿 DOC，以 Biancolella—Forastera 白葡萄配比与地方红葡萄为特色。

body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC recognized on 3 March 1966.
body.zh: 1966 年 3 月 3 日认可 DOC。

body.en: The production area is the island of Ischia in Naples province.
body.zh: 产区为 Napoli 省 Ischia 岛。

body.en: Volcanic island slopes are central. Casa D’Ambra documents vineyards from 100–500 m for its Ischia Bianco.
body.zh: 火山岛坡地为核心；Casa D’Ambra 记录其 Ischia Bianco 葡萄园海拔 100–500 米。

body.en: Forastera 45–70%, Biancolella 30–55%, with other eligible white grapes up to 15%.
body.zh: Forastera 45–70%，Biancolella 30–55%，其他合资格白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Guarnaccia 40–50%, Piedirosso 40–50%, with eligible red complements up to 15%. Guarnaccia identity remains a separate register task.
body.zh: Guarnaccia 40–50%，Piedirosso 40–50%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 15%；Guarnaccia 身份另待登记册核对。

body.en: Named Biancolella, Forastera and Piedirosso wines require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: 标示 Biancolella、Forastera、Piedirosso 的酒须至少含相应葡萄 85%。

body.en: Casa D’Ambra describes low trellis with Guyot pruning for its Ischia Bianco vineyards; this is a producer example.
body.zh: Casa D’Ambra 的 Ischia Bianco 葡萄园注明低架 Guyot 修剪；属酒庄实例。

body.en: Bianco, including Superiore and Spumante, Rosso and named varietal wines; Piedirosso also has a Passito type.
body.zh: Bianco 含 Superiore、Spumante，另有 Rosso 与品种酒；Piedirosso 另设 Passito。

body.en: Casa D’Ambra Ischia Bianco uses equal parts Biancolella and Forastera, a specific compliant blend rather than the general DOC formula.
body.zh: Casa D’Ambra Ischia Bianco 为 Biancolella、Forastera 各半，属符合法规的具体配比，而非全部 DOC 的固定配方。

body.en: Compare the two-grape Ischia Bianco with the producer’s Biancolella to study blend effect and varietal expression.
body.zh: 对比同庄双品种 Ischia Bianco 与 Biancolella，可研究混酿作用及品种表达。

intro.en: Salerno coastal DOC with Furore, Ravello and Tramonti subzones and a remarkable surviving local grape heritage.
intro.zh: Salerno 海岸 DOC，含 Furore、Ravello、Tramonti 子区，并保留重要地方葡萄遗产。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC established on 10 August 1995; the specification was subsequently amended, including in 2011.
body.zh: 1995 年 8 月 10 日设 DOC，之后包括 2011 年有规范修订。

body.en: Furore, Ravello and Tramonti have separate delimited subzones.
body.zh: Furore、Ravello、Tramonti 各有独立划界子区。

body.en: Furore includes steep sea-facing terraces; Tramonti lies farther inland. They should not be treated as one uniform growing environment.
body.zh: Furore 有陡峭向海梯田，Tramonti 更偏内陆，不应视为统一种植环境。

body.en: Marisa Cuomo documents dolomitic limestone at 200–550 m with southern exposure for Fiorduva.
body.zh: Marisa Cuomo 注明 Fiorduva 地块为白云质石灰岩、海拔 200–550 米、南向。

body.en: Basic white, passito and sparkling, and Ravello/Tramonti whites, require Falanghina and/or Biancolella at least 40%. Furore has a separate white formula.
body.zh: 基础白、Passito、起泡及 Ravello/Tramonti 白酒要求 Falanghina 和／或 Biancolella 至少 40%；Furore 白酒另有配方。

body.en: Fenile, Ginestra, Ripolo and Pepella are important white-grape references; Tintore is closely associated with Tramonti.
body.zh: Fenile、Ginestra、Ripolo、Pepella 为重要地方白葡萄参照；Tintore 紧密关联 Tramonti。

body.en: Fiorduva vineyards employ pergola/raggiera and espalier systems on terraces; the estate reports very late harvest into late October.
body.zh: Fiorduva 梯田采用 pergola/raggiera 与篱架；酒庄注明非常晚采，至 10 月下旬。

body.en: White, white Passito and Spumante, red, red Passito and rosé are distinguished in the specification.
body.zh: 法规区分白酒、白 Passito、Spumante、红酒、红 Passito 与桃红。

body.en: 30% Fenile, 30% Ginestra and 40% Ripoli; this wine-specific blend must not replace the general DOC rules.
body.zh: 30% Fenile、30% Ginestra、40% Ripoli；该酒特定配比不可替代全 DOC 规范。

body.en: Super-ripe grapes, low-temperature fermentation in oak barrels and approximately three months fermentation are producer-reported choices.
body.zh: 过熟葡萄、橡木桶低温发酵、约三个月发酵期，均为酒庄所述选择。

body.en: Compare richness, acidity and oak influence independently; Fiorduva represents a concentrated premium style within a broader denomination.
body.zh: 分别判断饱满度、酸度与橡木；Fiorduva 是广泛法定区内的浓缩高端风格实例。

intro.en: Asprinio-based white and sparkling DOC across the Aversa plain, including the historic alberata training tradition.
intro.zh: Aversa 平原以 Asprinio 为主的白及起泡 DOC，包含历史 alberata 树附式栽培传统。

body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC recognized on 31 July 1993.
body.zh: 1993 年 7 月 31 日认可 DOC。

body.en: Nineteen communes in Caserta province, plus Giugliano in Campania, Qualiano and Sant’Antimo in Naples province.
body.zh: Caserta 省十九市镇，加 Napoli 省 Giugliano in Campania、Qualiano、Sant’Antimo。

body.en: Asprinio at least 85%; eligible white complements up to 15%.
body.zh: Asprinio 至少 85%；其他合资格白葡萄最多 15%。

body.en: Asprinio 100%.
body.zh: Asprinio 100%。

body.en: Vines climb living poplar supports, reaching heights that require ladders for vineyard work and harvest.
body.zh: 葡萄攀附活杨树支撑，形成需梯子作业、采收的高架系统。

body.en: Modern lower training systems also exist; the Asprinio study compares alberata with espalier rather than treating all Aversa vineyards as alberata.
body.zh: 现代低架系统亦存在；Asprinio 研究比较 alberata 与篱架，并非所有 Aversa 葡萄园均为 alberata。

body.en: Aversa is the protected DOC name; Asprinio identifies its principal grape and traditional wine identity.
body.zh: Aversa 为受保护 DOC 名，Asprinio 说明主要葡萄与传统酒身份。

body.en: High natural acidity supports both dry still wines and sparkling production; the pure-variety requirement is stricter for sparkling.
body.zh: 高天然酸度支持干型静止与起泡酿造，起泡的纯品种要求更严格。

body.en: Use acidity and restrained aroma as structural reference points; compare training and cellar choices only where bottle-specific evidence is available.
body.zh: 以酸度与克制香气为结构参照，架式与酒窖选择须有酒款具体证据再比较。

intro.zh: Somma–Vesuvius DOC，含 Lacryma Christi 风格及 2025 规范扩展的品种类别。

body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Campania
body.zh: Campania

body.en: DOC approved on 13 January 1983.
body.zh: 1983 年 1 月 13 日批准 DOC。

body.en: Regulation EU 2025/1903 was published on 22 September 2025 and incorporated in the regional consolidated specification.
body.zh: 欧盟 2025/1903 法规于 2025 年 9 月 22 日公布，纳入大区汇总规范。

body.en: The entire communes of Boscotrecase, Trecase and San Sebastiano al Vesuvio, and delimited portions of surrounding Naples communes.
body.zh: 完整 Boscotrecase、Trecase、San Sebastiano al Vesuvio 及周边 Napoli 市镇划定部分。

body.en: Vineyards surround the Somma–Vesuvius complex, with altitude and exposure changing around its slopes.
body.zh: 葡萄园环绕 Somma–Vesuvius 山体，坡面海拔、朝向各异。

body.en: The specification identifies well-exposed sloping volcanic soils rich in potassium as suitable.
body.zh: 规范将朝向良好的坡地、富钾火山土列为适宜条件。

body.en: Caprettone and/or Coda di Volpe at least 45%; Falanghina and/or Greco up to 35%; other eligible whites up to 20%.
body.zh: Caprettone 和／或 Coda di Volpe 至少 45%；Falanghina 和／或 Greco 最多 35%；其他合资格白葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Piedirosso at least 50%; the legal text lists Sciascinoso Olivella and/or Aglianico up to 30%; other eligible red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Piedirosso 至少 50%；法规列 Sciascinoso Olivella 和／或 Aglianico 最多 30%；其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Caprettone, Falanghina, Piedirosso and Aglianico types each require at least 85% of the named grape.
body.zh: Caprettone、Falanghina、Piedirosso、Aglianico 类型各须所标葡萄至少 85%。

body.en: Caprettone has its own register entry and must remain distinct from Coda di Volpe. Catalanesca cultivation on Monte Somma does not make it a named Vesuvio DOC type.
body.zh: Caprettone 有独立登记，不可与 Coda di Volpe 合并。Monte Somma 种植 Catalanesca 不代表其为 Vesuvio DOC 标示品种类型。

body.en: Basic wines and named varietal wines have a 10 t/ha maximum; Lacryma Christi white/red Superiore and red Riserva have 8.5 t/ha.
body.zh: 基础及标示品种酒最高 10 t/ha；Lacryma Christi 白红 Superiore、红 Riserva 为 8.5 t/ha。

body.en: An authorized designation within Vesuvio DOC, covering white, red, rosé and specified sparkling/concentrated categories; it is not a separate DOC.
body.zh: 为 Vesuvio DOC 内获准名称，涵盖白红桃红及指定起泡、浓缩类型，非独立 DOC。

body.en: Lacryma Christi includes white Superiore, Passito and Liquoroso in addition to its still and sparkling white categories.
body.zh: Lacryma Christi 除静止、起泡白外，还含白 Superiore、Passito、Liquoroso。

body.en: Traditional still wines, sparkling fermentation, grape drying and fortified Liquoroso require separate production and analytical specifications.
body.zh: 传统静止、起泡发酵、葡萄干化、加强 Liquoroso 适用各自生产及分析规范。

body.en: Compare like categories: a Lacryma Christi red Riserva, a dry white and a white Liquoroso have different structural and service needs.
body.zh: 应同类比较：Lacryma Christi 红 Riserva、干白、白 Liquoroso 的结构及侍酒需求不同。

role.en: White principal; named type at least 85%.
role.zh: 白酒主要葡萄；标示类型至少 85%。

role.en: Shares the minimum 45% white component with Caprettone.
role.zh: 与 Caprettone 共享白酒至少 45% 主组成。

role.en: At least 50% basic red/rosé; named type at least 85%.
role.zh: 基础红桃红至少 50%，标示类型至少 85%。

role.en: Red blend component under the legal Sciascinoso Olivella wording.
role.zh: 法规 Sciascinoso Olivella 措辞下的红酒组成。

intro.zh: 以 Caserta 为核心的地理标志，Pallagrello、Casavecchia 保育酒款的重要载体。

body.en: IGT recognized in November 1995.
body.zh: 1995 年 11 月认可 IGT。

body.en: Vestini Campagnano documents recovery and renewed vinification of Pallagrello Bianco, Pallagrello Nero and Casavecchia.
body.zh: Vestini Campagnano 记录 Pallagrello Bianco、Pallagrello Nero、Casavecchia 的保育与重新酿造。

body.en: Delimited Caserta communes include Caiazzo, Castel Campagnano and Pontelatone; Giugliano in Campania, Qualiano and Sant’Antimo extend the zone into Naples province.
body.zh: 指定 Caserta 市镇包括 Caiazzo、Castel Campagnano、Pontelatone；Giugliano in Campania、Qualiano、Sant’Antimo 将范围延至 Napoli 省。

body.en: Named varietal wines require at least 85% of the named grape; Pallagrello Bianco, Pallagrello Nero and Casavecchia are key local examples.
body.zh: 标示品种酒至少含所标葡萄 85%；Pallagrello Bianco、Pallagrello Nero、Casavecchia 为重要地方实例。

body.en: Pallagrello Bianco is distinct from Coda di Volpe; the white and red Pallagrello names do not alone prove a colour-mutation relationship.
body.zh: Pallagrello Bianco 与 Coda di Volpe 不同；白红 Pallagrello 同名本身不能证明色变关系。

body.en: White, red and rosé, including permitted Amabile and Frizzante versions; white/red Passito and red Novello are also specified.
body.zh: 白红桃红，含获准 Amabile、Frizzante；另有白红 Passito 与红 Novello。

body.en: Terre del Volturno IGT must not be merged with Casavecchia di Pontelatone DOC.
body.zh: 不可与 Casavecchia di Pontelatone DOC 合并。

body.en: The IGT accommodates both blends and varietal expressions; bottle records should retain producer proportions and exact legal designation.
body.zh: IGT 容纳混酿与品种表达；酒款档案须保留酒庄配比及精确法定标示。

body.en: Compare Pallagrello Bianco and Nero as separate cultivars, then Casavecchia as a separate red identity.
body.zh: Pallagrello Bianco 与 Nero 按独立品种比较，再以 Casavecchia 作另一红葡萄对照。

role.en: Local varietal wine; minimum 85% when named.
role.zh: 地方品种酒；标示时至少 85%。

intro.en: Northern Basilicata Aglianico DOC, including still and red sparkling wines, separate from the Superiore DOCG.
intro.zh: Basilicata 北部 Aglianico DOC，含静止与红起泡，与 Superiore DOCG 分开。

body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.zh: Basilicata

body.en: DOC recognized in 1971.
body.zh: 1971 年认可 DOC。

body.en: Aglianico del Vulture Superiore became a separate DOCG in 2010.
body.zh: Aglianico del Vulture Superiore 于 2010 年成为独立 DOCG。

body.en: Fifteen communes in Potenza province; three outlying Atella territories are excluded by the boundary clause.
body.zh: Potenza 省十五市镇；边界条款排除 Atella 三块外飞地。

body.en: Eligible vineyards are between 200 and 700 m.
body.zh: 合资格葡萄园海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Summer dryness and substantial day–night variation coexist with rain risk during the late October–November harvest period.
body.zh: 夏季干燥及明显昼夜温差，与 10 月下旬至 11 月采收期降雨风险并存。

body.en: Volcanic materials coexist with sedimentary formations. Porous tuff can retain water useful during the dry season.
body.zh: 火山物质与沉积岩层并存，多孔凝灰岩可保存旱季所需水分。

body.en: The specification permits Aglianico del Vulture N. and/or Aglianico N.; the library links the Aglianico cultivar without inventing a second grape.
body.zh: 法规允许 Aglianico del Vulture N. 和／或 Aglianico N.；库内关联 Aglianico 品种，不另造第二品种。

body.en: Maximum 10 t/ha; alberello and simple trellised systems are traditional references.
body.zh: 最高 10 t/ha；alberello 与简单篱架为传统架式参照。

body.en: Still red and red Spumante; Superiore belongs to the separate DOCG.
body.zh: 静止红与红 Spumante；Superiore 属另一 DOCG。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 12.5%; still wine may range from dry to abboccato with residual sugar up to 10 g/L.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 12.5%；静止酒可干至 abboccato，残糖最多 10 g/L。

body.en: Still DOC wine cannot be released before 1 September of the year after harvest.
body.zh: 静止 DOC 不得早于采收翌年 9 月 1 日上市。

body.en: Red sparkling wine uses bottle refermentation and at least nine months of processing; approved sweetness spans Brut to Extra Dry.
body.zh: 红起泡采用瓶中二发，制作期至少九个月；获准甜度从 Brut 至 Extra Dry。

body.en: Compare the DOC and Superiore DOCG by yield, maturation and release dates before assessing producer extraction and oak choices.
body.zh: 比较 DOC、Superiore DOCG 时先核产量、熟成、上市日期，再判断酒庄萃取与橡木选择。

role.en: Exclusive grape identity under the legal Aglianico wording.
role.zh: 法规 Aglianico 名称下的唯一葡萄身份。

intro.zh: 静止红 Aglianico DOCG，产量更低，法定熟成长于相邻 DOC 类别。

body.zh: 2010 年设 DOCG。

body.en: The same fifteen-commune Vulture production zone in Potenza province, with the specified Atella exclusions.
body.zh: Potenza 省同一十五市镇 Vulture 产区，保留指定 Atella 排除范围。

body.en: Eligible sites occupy the 200–700 m band.
body.zh: 合资格地块海拔 200–700 米。

body.en: Volcanic materials and sedimentary layers create varied soils around Vulture; the DOCG is not one identical volcanic soil.
body.zh: Vulture 周边火山物质与沉积层形成不同土壤，DOCG 并非单一相同火山土。

body.en: Aglianico del Vulture N. and/or Aglianico N. in the legal text.
body.zh: 法规采用 Aglianico del Vulture N. 和／或 Aglianico N. 名称。

body.en: Maximum 8 t/ha, lower than the DOC’s 10 t/ha.
body.zh: 最高 8 t/ha，低于 DOC 的 10 t/ha。

body.en: Maximum conversion 65%, corresponding to 52 hl/ha at the maximum grape yield.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 65%，在最高葡萄产量下为 52 hl/ha。

body.en: Still red only; minimum total alcohol 13.5% and total acidity 4.5 g/L.
body.zh: 仅静止红，最低总酒精度 13.5%，总酸 4.5 g/L。

body.en: Not before 1 November of the third year after harvest; at least twelve months in wood and twelve months in bottle.
body.zh: 不得早于采收后第三年 11 月 1 日；至少十二个月木桶及十二个月瓶陈。

body.en: Not before 1 November of the fifth year after harvest; at least twenty-four months wood and twelve months bottle.
body.zh: 不得早于采收后第五年 11 月 1 日；至少二十四个月木桶及十二个月瓶陈。

body.en: Paternoster currently identifies Don Anselmo as Aglianico del Vulture Superiore DOCG. Historical DOC-labelled vintages must retain their original category.
body.zh: Paternoster 当前将 Don Anselmo 标为 Aglianico del Vulture Superiore DOCG；历史 DOC 酒标年份应保留原分类。

body.en: Assess tannin, development and sediment before decanting; the compulsory maturation period does not itself guarantee peak drinking maturity.
body.zh: 醒酒前评估单宁、发展及沉淀；达到法定熟成年限不代表已在最佳适饮期。

intro.en: Matera-province DOC with specified Sangiovese, Primitivo, Greco and international-variety blends across warmer southeastern Basilicata.
intro.zh: 涵盖 Basilicata 东南部较暖区域的 Matera 省 DOC，规范 Sangiovese、Primitivo、Greco 及国际品种配比。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Basilicata
body.zh: Basilicata

body.en: DOC established in July 2005 and expanded in the 2011 specification.
body.zh: 2005 年 7 月设 DOC，2011 年规范扩展。

body.en: The entire province of Matera, from inland hills to the Ionian coastal plain.
body.zh: 覆盖整个 Matera 省，从内陆丘陵至爱奥尼亚海岸平原。

body.en: Metapontine coastal plain, marine terraces and Bradanic hills create several growing environments.
body.zh: Metapontine 海岸平原、海成阶地、Bradanic 丘陵构成多个栽培环境。

body.en: The Metapontine and Bradano sectors are among the warmest; summer drought is a defining constraint.
body.zh: Metapontine、Bradano 地带较暖，夏季干旱为重要约束。

body.en: Calcareous sands, conglomerates, marls and clays differ across the province; these are not all Vulture volcanic soils.
body.zh: 钙质砂、砾岩、泥灰岩及黏土在省内各异，并非全为 Vulture 火山土。

body.en: Sangiovese at least 60%, Primitivo at least 30%, eligible red complements up to 10%.
body.zh: Sangiovese 至少 60%，Primitivo 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 10%。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon at least 60%, Primitivo at least 20%, Merlot at least 10%; other eligible red grapes up to 10%.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 60%，Primitivo 至少 20%，Merlot 至少 10%；其他合资格红葡萄最多 10%。

body.en: Primitivo and Primitivo Passito require at least 90% Primitivo; Rosato also requires at least 90%.
body.zh: Primitivo、Primitivo Passito 至少含 Primitivo 90%；Rosato 同样至少 90%。

body.en: Named Greco requires at least 85% Greco.
body.zh: 标示 Greco 至少含 Greco 85%。

body.en: The denomination also provides white, white Passito and white/rosé sparkling categories alongside its specified reds.
body.zh: 除指定红酒外，亦设白酒、白 Passito、白及桃红起泡类型。

body.en: Still, sparkling and dried-grape styles require separate cellar practices and analysis; Moro is a blend category, not a grape name.
body.zh: 静止、起泡、干化葡萄风格须分别处理工艺及指标；Moro 为混酿类别，非葡萄名称。

body.en: Compare Rosso with Moro to assess the change from Sangiovese-led to Cabernet-led structure, keeping Primitivo’s role visible.
body.zh: 比较 Rosso 与 Moro，可研究 Sangiovese 主导至 Cabernet 主导的结构变化，并保留 Primitivo 作用。

role.en: Primitivo local name; principal component of several types.
role.zh: 地方名称 Primitivo，多种类型的重要组成。

intro.en: Interior Potenza valley DOC structured around Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, with a distinctive Malvasia contribution to rosé.
intro.zh: Potenza 内陆河谷 DOC，以 Merlot、Cabernet Sauvignon 为骨架，桃红特别要求 Malvasia 组成。

body.en: DOC / PDO
body.zh: DOC / PDO

body.en: Italy
body.zh: 意大利

body.en: Basilicata
body.zh: Basilicata

body.en: DOC established in September 2003.
body.zh: 2003 年 9 月设 DOC。

body.en: Viggiano, Grumento Nova and Moliterno in Potenza province.
body.zh: Potenza 省 Viggiano、Grumento Nova、Moliterno。

body.en: Vineyards may be planted up to 800 m; the geographic link describes typical vineyards between 600 and 800 m.
body.zh: 葡萄园允许至 800 米；地理关联章节描述典型葡萄园在 600–800 米。

body.en: Interior valley conditions combine autumn/spring rain, dry summers and marked day–night temperature variation.
body.zh: 内陆河谷兼有秋春降雨、干燥夏季及明显昼夜温差。

body.en: The intermontane valley has Pleistocene lake deposits overlain by recent alluvium; silty-sandy and silty-clay textures with stony material recur.
body.zh: 山间谷地含更新世湖相沉积及较新冲积覆盖，常见含石的粉砂—砂质、粉砂—黏质土。

body.en: Merlot at least 50%, Cabernet Sauvignon at least 30%, eligible other red grapes up to 20%.
body.zh: Merlot 至少 50%，Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 30%，其他合资格红葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Merlot at least 50%, Cabernet Sauvignon at least 20%, Malvasia di Basilicata at least 10%; permitted complements up to 20%.
body.zh: Merlot 至少 50%，Cabernet Sauvignon 至少 20%，Malvasia di Basilicata 至少 10%；允许辅助最多 20%。

body.en: New/replanted vineyards require at least 3,000 vines/ha. Simple trellising is the reference; pergola and tendone are excluded from alternative approvals.
body.zh: 新植、重植至少 3,000 株/ha，以简单篱架为参照；其他架式审批排除 pergola、tendone。

body.en: Maximum 12 t/ha for all three types.
body.zh: 三个类型均最高 12 t/ha。

body.en: Rosso, Rosso Riserva and Rosato; this DOC is distinct from Aglianico del Vulture.
body.zh: Rosso、Rosso Riserva、Rosato；该 DOC 与 Aglianico del Vulture 不同。

body.en: Maximum wine conversion 70%, equivalent to 84 hl/ha at the yield limit.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 70%，产量上限下相当于 84 hl/ha。

body.en: At least twelve months from 1 November following the harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后 11 月 1 日起至少十二个月。

body.en: At least twenty-four months, including six months in wood, from 1 November following the harvest.
body.zh: 自采收后 11 月 1 日起至少二十四个月，其中六个月木桶。

body.en: Rosato is released after 1 March of the year following harvest.
body.zh: Rosato 于采收翌年 3 月 1 日之后上市。

body.en: The rosé contains a compulsory white-grape contribution; its recipe must not be copied from the red blend.
body.zh: 桃红含强制白葡萄组成，不可照搬红酒配比。

corrections.issue: Some promotional summaries use 1 January after harvest.
corrections.resolution: Approved 2020 Taurasi specification starts ageing on 1 December of harvest year.

corrections.issue: Old overview prose retains a Sangiovese-led Pentro blend.
corrections.resolution: Use the 2014 law: Montepulciano 75–80%, Tintilia 20–25%; the ten-year vineyard transition began 1 August 2014.

corrections.issue: Promotional FAQ descriptions can imply tank fermentation or one uniform lees minimum.
corrections.resolution: Approved law requires traditional bottle fermentation: 18 months Spumante, 36 months Spumante Riserva.

corrections.issue: A proposal date was liable to be confused with EU approval.

corrections.issue: Older summaries omit the expanded categories and updated composition.
